integrity: The asymptotic proof relies on a published multivariate Poisson approximation and explicit finite-neighborhood bounds. Reproducible finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The count-vector theorem is for a fixed strictly positive color vector on independently colored binary hypercubes.
The logical limit procedure only covers Boolean combinations of fixed first-order star-threshold sentences.
Weber (1987) contains closely related site-percolation Poisson theorems; its full text was unavailable for statement-level comparison.
No claim of independent proof verification or priority certification is made.
title: Half-mass Poisson independence and first-order star limits on colored hypercubes
